ShortDescription.Value: Fix Not Enough Customers icons by balancing commercial shop production and shopping demand.

Publish.LongDescription:
# 🛒
## "Not Enough Customers" icons everywhere?
Adding more citizens doesn't always help!
### Why this happens
* NEC icons appear when a commercial shop is over **90%+ unused Service** (different from stock). * Vanilla puts **50%–100% full shops in the same bucket**. A shop at critical 91% full doesn't really get the priority it needs over one at 52% * So citizens can keep going to healthier shops while desperate shops are still ignored that are 90% + full. The system seems disconnected to the NEC trigger point. * Shop workers get paid to produce Service. Service is different from goods (e.g., food, paper...) you see delivered. * Vanilla does slow worker production a little starting at 80% full Service to help out. But by 90% critical threshold, it's still producing too much. * Vanilla doesn't clamp production to 0% until the shop hits full 100%, way too late to prevent NEC icons. * Also, cims at work/school can not shop, so we get peak periods with a lot less eligible shoppers. Only elderly or adults not in school/work are available during that time.
**Shops workers end up making "Service" faster than current available shoppers can use it.** Adding more citizens didn't fix this for many players when the 90%+ shops aren't also getting prioritized.
### Some mod test results
* **130k city:** 165 NEC -> only 4 after ~30 minutes. * **90k city:** 335 NEC -> only 30 after 10 min., 9 after 20 min.
### How does the mod work?
* Just install the mod and play! No Options menu or settings to configure. * **Starts helping when shop hits ~82% full Service**, before the critical 90% threshold causes an alert icon. Many rates were tested to optimize for good, realistic rate buckets. * Once healthy again (below 82%), it goes back to vanilla to handle normally. * Just like real life, shops reduce worker production at times of day when there are not enough shoppers to reduce service levels. No fake shoppers are made; balancing your existing cims is often enough. * **Leisure** businesses are also helped (Meals, Entertainment, Recreation). * **Hotels** are best-effort, using existing tourists as Hotels are based on total rooms rented. No fake tourists added. I had 8 hotels, 9000 rooms for 700 tourists. The mod got my NEC hotels from all 8 to only 4, after which I had to delete a couple or use static Hotel buildings.
### What to expect * Give cities 15–30 minutes to rebalance; many changes happen within 5 minutes. * After 30+ minutes, if you have a few 10-20 left over, now is time to prune a few shops. Don't need to prune the exact left over shops. * It won't fix every case of legit excess commercial zoning or poor access to shops. * Safe to remove, Vanilla takes over again. No Harmony patch means more compatible with other mods and the game. * Companion [mod City Watchdog](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/144908/Windows) recommended to easily see totals go up/down like shown in the screenshot. Make sure to put a "blue star" next to Not Enough Customers.
